summary: Ran a fresh isolated Chromium context against https://autopilot.local/moje-konto/ without submitting login, registration, password-recovery, order, payment or email data. Login and registration fields accepted focus, the remember-me checkbox toggled and was restored, registration details opened and closed, both forms retained POST actions and nonces, and no console/page errors occurred. Two functional state defects remain.
issues: AUD-ACCOUNT-INTERACTION-001 | priority: high | property: lost-password flow | expected: ‘Nie pamiętam hasła’ opens the native WooCommerce password-recovery form | actual: /moje-konto/lost-password/ returns HTTP 200 but contains zero WooCommerce reset forms and renders account-login plus account-registration again | fix: dispatch the WooCommerce lost-password endpoint before the unconditional account authentication partial.

AUD-ACCOUNT-INTERACTION-002 | priority: medium | property: registration disclosure localization | expected: the expanded registration state remains Polish and uses native editable project content | actual: opening the registration details exposes the English WooCommerce default ‘Your personal data will be used…’ disclosure | fix: configure localized Polish WooCommerce privacy text or a project-owned editable equivalent.
